strings.name: Venu Srinivasan
strings.summary: Trained in engineering and management, Venu Srinivasan began leading Sundaram-Clayton in 1979 and subsequently led TVS Motor for many years. He promoted manufacturing quality management and received the Deming overseas service award and Padma Bhushan. His recent public activities also involve a family asset dispute and proceedings concerning a temple idol case.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 18, 2026. The temple case update follows reporting of October 14 and the family asset dispute follows reporting of November 16; later court outcomes are not inferred.
strings.influence.rationale: Leads TVS's vehicle manufacturing business, advancing India's two-wheeler industry and quality management systems.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Engineering bachelor's degree from the University of Madras and a master's in management from Purdue University, class of 1977.
strings.facts.f2.label: Family and career
strings.facts.f2.value: Grandson of TVS group founder T. V. Sundaram Iyengar; became TVS Motor's managing director in 1986 and also chairman in July 2002.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Developing two-wheeler manufacturing
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led TVS Motor's business over many years, advancing its manufacturing systems and quality management.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Recognition for promoting quality management
strings.highlights.h2.text: Received JUSE's Deming Distinguished Service Award for Dissemination and Promotion Overseas in 2019, an individual honour.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Family asset dispute escalates publicly
strings.timeline.t1.text: PTI reported that his daughter Lakshmi sought partition of assets; he had maintained that the assets were personal property and their allocation was fair.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Challenge to temple case quashing order
strings.timeline.t2.text: Reporting described the Supreme Court hearing a challenge to the 2024 quashing decision; he denied involvement in the alleged idol theft.
strings.timeline.t3.title: High Court quashes criminal proceedings against him
strings.timeline.t3.text: The Madras High Court quashed the case against him in C.C.No.1 of 2023; the decision was subsequently challenged.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Becomes chairman emeritus
strings.timeline.t4.text: The board designated him TVS Motor's chairman emeritus while retaining him as managing director; Ralf Speth became chairman.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Awarded the Padma Bhushan for 2020
strings.timeline.t5.text: The government gazette listed him for trade and industry; the award year was 2020 and the conferral notification was issued in 2021.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Deming overseas service award announced
strings.timeline.t6.text: JUSE announced him as recipient of its award for distinguished service in dissemination and promotion overseas.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Takes charge at Sundaram-Clayton
strings.timeline.t7.text: Became managing director, subsequently spending many years managing automotive components and two-wheeler businesses.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completes Purdue management master's
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earned a master's degree in management at Purdue University in the United States.
